provenance: Self-written sentences, each output reviewed by hand. Owner verdict 10-11: a loanword Vietnamese readers settled on one Vietnamese reading (quán net -> nét) is read that way by every voice. direct = VieNeu (direct English), plain = every other voice before its own engine step.
